cases.case_label: 5'-truncated AluYb8 c.7981_7982ins in exon 54 of ATM
cases.mechanism_detail: A homozygous 5'-truncated AluYb8 (188-bp core plus ~25-bp polyA, 13-bp TSD) inserted in ATM exon 54 is predicted to cause a frameshift with a premature stop six residues downstream (p.Asp2661Valfs*7).
cases.quote: Alu element insertion was predicted to disrupt ATM coding sequence and to induce a premature stop codon six residues downstream the insertion
